# DTO Reference

Every request payload, response model and helper type used by `JubClient`. All Pydantic models live in `jub.dto.v2` (usually imported as `DTO`); enums live in `jub.enums`, and the bulk upload result types in `jub.client.v2`.

Methods that accept a DTO also accept a plain `dict` matching its schema. Type names in every table are links to their own definition.

```python
import jub.dto.v2 as DTO

dto = DTO.ObservatoryCreateDTO(title="Cancer Observatory")
```

## Users

Authentication, profiles and preferences.

### `SignUpDTO` { #signupdto }

*Pydantic model*

Payload for creating a new user account.

**Accepted by:** [`signup()`](api-reference.md#signup)

| Field | Type | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `username` | `str` | Yes | — | Unique login handle. |
| `first_name` | `str` | No | `""` | Optional first name of the user. |
| `last_name` | `str` | No | `""` | Optional last name of the user. |
| `email` | `str` | Yes | — | User email address. |
| `password` | `str` | Yes | — | Plain-text password (transmitted over HTTPS only). |
| `profile_photo` | `str` | No | `""` | Optional URL of the user's profile photo. |
| `scope` | `Optional[str]` | No | `"jub"` | Optional scope of the user's access (e.g. 'admin', 'analyst'). |
| `expiration` | `Optional[str]` | No | `"1y"` | Optional ISO 8601 datetime string indicating when the user's access expires. |

### `AuthAttemptDTO` { #authattemptdto }

*Pydantic model*

Payload for POST /users/auth.

| Field | Type | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `username` | `str` | Yes | — | Account login handle. |
| `password` | `str` | Yes | — | Plain-text password. |
| `scope` | `str` | No | `"jub"` | JWT token scope. |
| `expiration` | `Optional[str]` | No | `"1h"` | Requested token lifetime (e.g. 1h, 30m). |
| `renew_token` | `Optional[bool]` | No | `False` | Whether the server should issue a renewable token. |

### `AuthResponseDTO` { #authresponsedto }

*Pydantic model*

Response for POST /users/auth and POST /users/signup.

| Field | Type | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `access_token` | `str` | Yes | — | JWT sent as a Bearer token on subsequent requests. |
| `temporal_secret_key` | `Optional[str]` | No | `None` | Secret for internal service-to-service authentication, if issued. |
| `user_profile` | <code><a href="#userprofiledto">UserProfileDTO</a></code> | Yes | — | Profile of the authenticated user. |

Response for GET /users/me.

| Field | Type | Required | Default | Description |

| `username` | `str` | Yes | — | Login handle. |
| `fullname` | `str` | No | `""` | Full name of the user, combining first and last name if available. |
| `first_name` | `str` | No | `""` | Optional first name of the user. |
| `last_name` | `str` | No | `""` | Optional last name of the user. |
| `email` | `str` | Yes | — | User email address. |
| `settings` | <code><a href="#userpreferencesdto">UserPreferencesDTO</a></code> | No | `UserPreferencesDTO()` | The user's saved preferences. |
| `created_at` | `str` | No | `""` | ISO 8601 datetime string indicating when the user account was created. |
| `updated_at` | `str` | No | `""` | ISO 8601 datetime string indicating when the user account was last updated. |
| `is_disabled` | `bool` | No | `False` | Whether the user account is disabled. |

## Catalogs

Controlled vocabularies and their nested items.

### `CatalogCreateDTO` { #catalogcreatedto }

*Pydantic model*

Payload for POST /catalogs.

**Accepted by:** [`create_catalog()`](api-reference.md#create_catalog)

| Field | Type | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `catalog_id` | `Optional[str]` | No | `None` | Optional pre-defined ID for the catalog. If not provided, a random UUID is generated. |
| `name` | `str` | Yes | — | Human-readable name of the catalog. |
| `value` | `str` | Yes | — | Stored value used in queries (UPPER_SNAKE_CASE). |
| `catalog_type` | `str` | Yes | — | Classification of the catalog (SPATIAL, TEMPORAL, INTEREST, etc.). |
| `description` | `str` | No | `""` | Optional description providing context. |
| `items` | <code>List[<a href="#catalogitemcreatedto">CatalogItemCreateDTO</a>]</code> | No | `[]` | List of catalog items to create together with the catalog. |

### `CatalogItemCreateDTO` { #catalogitemcreatedto }

*Pydantic model*

Payload for creating a catalog item within a new catalog.

This model is recursive to support hierarchical catalog structures.

| Field | Type | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `catalog_item_id` | `Optional[str]` | No | `None` | Optional pre-defined ID for the catalog item. If not provided, a random UUID is generated. |
| `name` | `str` | Yes | — | Human-readable display name. |
| `value` | `str` | Yes | — | Stored value used in queries (typically UPPER_SNAKE_CASE). |
| `code` | `int` | Yes | — | Numeric code uniquely identifying the item. |
| `value_type` | `str` | Yes | — | Data type of the value (STRING, NUMBER, BOOLEAN, DATETIME). |
| `description` | `Optional[str]` | No | `""` | Optional description providing context about the catalog item. |
| `temporal_value` | `Optional[str]` | No | `None` | Optional ISO 8601 datetime string for temporal items. |
| `aliases` | <code>List[<a href="#catalogitemaliascreatedto">CatalogItemAliasCreateDTO</a>]</code> | No | `[]` | List of alternative names or codes for this item. |
| `children` | <code>List[<a href="#catalogitemcreatedto">CatalogItemCreateDTO</a>]</code> | No | `[]` | Nested child items for hierarchical catalogs. |

### `CatalogItemAliasCreateDTO` { #catalogitemaliascreatedto }

*Pydantic model*

Payload for creating an alias for a catalog item.

| Field | Type | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|

| `value` | `str` | Yes | — | The alias value string. |
| `value_type` | `str` | Yes | — | Type of the alias value (STRING, NUMBER, BOOLEAN, DATETIME). |
| `description` | `str` | No | `""` | Optional description for the alias. |

Payload for PUT /catalogs/{catalog_id}.

| `description` | `Optional[str]` | No | `None` | Updated description |

### `ObservatorySetupDTO` { #observatorysetupdto }

*Pydantic model*

Payload for POST /observatories/setup.

Creates a disabled observatory and queues a background setup task.
The observatory is enabled only when the task completes successfully
via POST /tasks/{task_id}/complete.

**Accepted by:** [`setup_observatory()`](api-reference.md#setup_observatory)

| Field | Type | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `observatory_id` | `Optional[str]` | No | `None` | Optional pre-defined ID for the observatory. If not provided, a random UUID is generated. |
| `title` | `str` | Yes | — | Display name of the observatory. |
| `description` | `str` | No | `""` | Optional description providing context about the observatory. |
| `image_url` | `str` | No | `""` | Optional URL of a representative image. |
| `metadata` | `Dict[str, str]` | No | `{}` | Optional metadata for the observatory. |

### `ObservatorySetupResponseDTO` { #observatorysetupresponsedto }

*Pydantic model*

Response for POST /observatories/setup.

**Returned by:** [`setup_observatory()`](api-reference.md#setup_observatory)

|---|---|---|---|---|
| `observatory_id` | `str` | Yes | — | ID of the created (disabled) observatory. |
| `task_id` | `str` | Yes | — | ID of the setup task; pass it to complete_task() when done. |
| `status` | `str` | No | `"pending"` | Initial status of the setup task. |
| `message` | `str` | No | `""` | Informational message from the API. |

## Bulk upload results

Plain dataclasses returned by the client-side upload queue. They are never sent to the API.

### `BulkUploadResult` { #bulkuploadresult }

*Dataclass*

Result of wait_uploads() and bulk_upload_products().

**Returned by:** [`bulk_upload_products()`](api-reference.md#bulk_upload_products), [`wait_uploads()`](api-reference.md#wait_uploads)

| Field | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `succeeded` | <code>List[<a href="#productuploadresponsedto">ProductUploadResponseDTO</a>]</code> | `[]` | Upload responses for every job that succeeded. |
| `failed` | <code>List[<a href="#faileduploadentry">FailedUploadEntry</a>]</code> | `[]` | Jobs that failed permanently after all retries. |
| `skipped` | `List[str]` | `[]` | Product IDs skipped because the upload registry already recorded them as succeeded. |

### `FailedUploadEntry` { #faileduploadentry }

*Dataclass*

An upload job that exhausted all retries without succeeding.

| Field | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `product_id` | `str` | — | ID of the product whose upload failed. |
| `attempts` | `int` | — | Total number of upload attempts made. |
| `last_error` | `str` | — | Error message from the last failed attempt. |

## Search

JUB DSL search and plotting payloads, and query suggestions.

### `SearchQueryDTO` { #searchquerydto }

*Pydantic model*

Payload for POST /search, /search/records, and /search/observatories.

The query field uses the JUB DSL (see Query Language section in CLAUDE.md).

**Accepted by:** [`search()`](api-reference.md#search), [`search_observatories()`](api-reference.md#search_observatories), [`search_records()`](api-reference.md#search_records)

| Field | Type | Required | Default | Description |

| `query` | `str` | Yes | — | JUB DSL query string (e.g. jub.v1.VS(MX).VT(>= 2020).VI(SEX_FEMALE)). |
| `observatory_id` | `Optional[str]` | No | `None` | Optional observatory ID to scope the search. |
| `limit` | `int` | No | `10` | Maximum number of results to return. |
| `skip` | `int` | No | `0` | Number of results to skip for pagination. |
| `strict` | `bool` | No | `True` | Reject queries that reference unknown catalog values instead of ignoring them. |
| `no_cache` | `bool` | No | `False` | Bypass the server-side result cache. |

### `PlotQueryDTO` { #plotquerydto }

Payload for POST /search/plot.

| Field | Type | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `query` | `str` | Yes | — | JUB DSL aggregation query string. |
| `observatory_id` | `Optional[str]` | No | `None` | Optional observatory ID to scope the query. |
| `chart_type` | `str` | No | `"bar"` | Chart type for the ECharts response (bar, line, pie, etc.). |
| `source_id` | `Optional[str]` | No | `None` | Optional data source ID to aggregate over. |
| `strict` | `bool` | No | `True` | Reject queries that reference unknown catalog values instead of ignoring them. |

### `SearchSuggestionItemDTO` { #searchsuggestionitemdto }

*Pydantic model*

A single suggested query with its number of hits.

| Field | Type | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `query` | `str` | Yes | — | Suggested JUB DSL query string. |
| `hit_count` | `int` | Yes | — | Number of results the query returns. |

| Field | Type | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `service_id` | `str` | Yes | — | Unique identifier of the service. |
| `name` | `str` | Yes | — | Service name. |
| `description` | `str` | No | `""` | Optional description. |
| `provider` | `Optional[str]` | No | `None` | Provider classification (see [`ServiceProviderEnum`](#serviceproviderenum)), if any. |
| `public` | `bool` | No | `False` | Whether the service is publicly discoverable. |

### `ServiceDeleteResponseDTO` { #servicedeleteresponsedto }

*Pydantic model*

Response for DELETE /services/{service_id}.

**Returned by:** [`delete_service()`](api-reference.md#delete_service)

| Field | Type | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `deleted` | `bool` | Yes | — | Whether the service was deleted. |
| `service_id` | `str` | Yes | — | ID of the deleted service. |
| `cascade` | `Dict[str, Any]` | No | `{}` | Counts of cascade-deleted entities (e.g. {'workflow': 1, 'stages': 3}). |

### `ServiceIndexDTO` { #serviceindexdto }

*Pydantic model*

Payload for POST /services/index.

One-shot request that creates the complete Service -> Workflow -> Stages ->
Patterns -> BuildingBlocks tree in a single call. At every level you can
either provide inline definitions or reference existing IDs.

**Accepted by:** [`index_service()`](api-reference.md#index_service)

| Field | Type | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `name` | `str` | Yes | — | Service name. |
| `owner_id` | `str` | Yes | — | User ID of the service owner. |
| `description` | `str` | No | `""` | Optional description providing context about the service. |
| `public` | `bool` | No | `False` | Whether this service is publicly discoverable via SVC() DSL queries. |
| `workflow` | <code>Optional[<a href="#workflowinlinedto">WorkflowInlineDTO</a>]</code> | No | `None` | Inline workflow definition to create together with the service. If provided, workflow_id must be null. |
| `workflow_id` | `Optional[str]` | No | `None` | ID of an existing workflow to attach instead of creating one inline. |
| `provider` | <code>Optional[<a href="#serviceproviderenum">ServiceProviderEnum</a>]</code> | No | `ServiceProviderEnum.OTHER` | Optional service provider classification (e.g. NEZ, XELHUA, EXTERNAL). |

### `WorkflowInlineDTO` { #workflowinlinedto }

*Pydantic model*

Inline workflow definition used inside [`ServiceIndexDTO`](#serviceindexdto).

| Field | Type | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `name` | `str` | Yes | — | Workflow name. |
| `stages` | <code>List[<a href="#stageinlinedto">StageInlineDTO</a>]</code> | No | `[]` | Ordered list of inline stage definitions (minimum one stage required). |

### `StageInlineDTO` { #stageinlinedto }

*Pydantic model*

Inline stage definition used inside [`ServiceIndexDTO`](#serviceindexdto).

Provide either transformation (to create a pattern inline) or
transformation_id (to reference an existing one). Both are optional.

| Field | Type | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `name` | `str` | Yes | — | Stage name. |
| `source` | `str` | Yes | — | Input source identifier or URI. |
| `sink` | `str` | Yes | — | Output sink identifier or URI. |
| `endpoint` | `str` | Yes | — | HTTP or messaging endpoint exposed by this stage. |
| `transformation` | <code>Optional[<a href="#patterninlinedto">PatternInlineDTO</a>]</code> | No | `None` | Inline pattern to create together with this stage. |
| `transformation_id` | `Optional[str]` | No | `None` | ID of an existing pattern to reference. |

### `PatternInlineDTO` { #patterninlinedto }

*Pydantic model*

Inline pattern definition used inside [`ServiceIndexDTO`](#serviceindexdto).

Provide either building_block (to create one inline) or building_block_id
(to reference an existing one). Both are optional.

| Field | Type | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `name` | `str` | Yes | — | Human-readable pattern name. |
| `task` | `str` | Yes | — | Task category. |
| `pattern` | `str` | Yes | — | Pattern type. |
| `description` | `str` | No | `""` | Optional description. |
| `workers` | `int` | No | `1` | Number of parallel worker instances. |
| `loadbalancer` | `str` | No | `"round-robin"` | Load-balancing strategy. |
| `building_block` | <code>Optional[<a href="#buildingblockinlinedto">BuildingBlockInlineDTO</a>]</code> | No | `None` | Inline building block to create together with this pattern. |
| `building_block_id` | `Optional[str]` | No | `None` | ID of an existing building block to reference. |

### `BuildingBlockInlineDTO` { #buildingblockinlinedto }

*Pydantic model*

Inline building block definition used inside [`ServiceIndexDTO`](#serviceindexdto).

| Field | Type | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `name` | `str` | Yes | — | Human-readable identifier. |
| `command` | `str` | Yes | — | Container entrypoint command. |
| `image` | `str` | Yes | — | Docker image reference. |
| `description` | `str` | No | `""` | Optional description. |

### `ServiceIndexResponseDTO` { #serviceindexresponsedto }

*Pydantic model*

Response for POST /services/index.

Summary of every entity created or referenced during the bulk index call.

**Returned by:** [`index_service()`](api-reference.md#index_service)

| Field | Type | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `service_id` | `str` | Yes | — | ID of the created service. |
| `workflow_id` | `Optional[str]` | No | `None` | ID of the created or referenced workflow, if any. |
| `stage_ids` | `List[str]` | No | `[]` | IDs of all created stages. |
| `pattern_ids` | `List[str]` | No | `[]` | IDs of all created patterns. |
| `building_block_ids` | `List[str]` | No | `[]` | IDs of all created building blocks. |

### `ServiceQueryDTO` { #servicequerydto }

*Pydantic model*

Payload for POST /services/search (Services DSL search).

DSL query uses the SVC() operator:
    jub.v1.SVC(*)                       -- all services
    jub.v1.SVC(name=cancer)             -- name contains 'cancer'
    jub.v1.SVC(public=true)             -- public only
    jub.v1.SVC(owner=usr_abc)           -- by owner
    jub.v1.SVC(name=cancer,public=true) -- combined

**Accepted by:** [`search_services()`](api-reference.md#search_services)

| Field | Type | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `query` | `str` | Yes | — | Services DSL query string. |
| `limit` | `int` | No | `100` | Maximum number of results to return (1-1000). |
| `skip` | `int` | No | `0` | Number of results to skip for pagination. |

## Domain models

Core STORI entities. See also the [Data Model](data-model.md) page.

### `Observatory` { #observatory }

*Pydantic model*

Represents an observatory in the JUB domain.

Unlike the V1 model, this does not contain direct references to catalogs.
Relationships are represented through ObservatoryCatalogLink.

| Field | Type | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `obid` | `str` | No | `""` | Unique identifier of the observatory. |
| `title` | `str` | No | `"Observatory"` | Display name of the observatory. |
| `image_url` | `str` | No | `""` | URL of an image representing the observatory. |
| `description` | `str` | No | `""` | Textual description providing context. |
| `disabled` | `bool` | No | `False` | Whether the observatory is inactive. |

### `Catalog` { #catalog }

*Pydantic model*

Represents a catalog in the JUB domain.

This version removes the embedded items collection.
Relationships between catalogs and items are expressed via CatalogItemLink.

| Field | Type | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `cid` | `str` | No | `""` | Unique identifier of the catalog. |
| `display_name` | `str` | No | `""` | Human-readable name of the catalog. Normalizes display_name by collapsing consecutive whitespace into a single space. |
| `kind` | `str` | No | `""` | Type of the catalog (e.g. TEMPORAL, SPATIAL, INTEREST). |

### `CatalogItem` { #catalogitem }

*Pydantic model*

Represents an item within a catalog.

This model is no longer attached to the Catalog model directly.
Relationships are now represented through CatalogItemLink.

| Field | Type | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `item_id` | `str` | Yes | — | Unique identifier of the catalog item. |
| `value` | `str` | Yes | — | Value used for storage and querying. |
| `display_name` | `str` | Yes | — | Human-readable name for the catalog item. Normalizes display_name by collapsing consecutive whitespace into a single space. |
| `code` | `int` | Yes | — | Unique numeric code identifying the catalog item. |
| `description` | `str` | Yes | — | Textual description providing context. |
| `metadata` | `Dict[str, str]` | Yes | — | Extra key-value data providing context about the item. |

### `Product` { #product }

*Pydantic model*

Represents a product in the JUB domain.

This version removes the levels field used in V1 for catalog references.

| Field | Type | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `pid` | `str` | No | `""` | Product unique identifier. |
| `description` | `str` | No | `""` | Textual description of the product. |
| `product_type` | `str` | No | `""` | Category of the product. |
| `product_name` | `str` | No | `""` | Display name of the product. |
| `tags` | `List[str]` | No | `[]` | Tags for permission control and filtering. |
| `url` | `str` | No | `""` | Path to the product in the application. |
